initial_proposal_issue_fixed.issue: Initial proposal discarded the guard-normalized absolute path then expanded/absolutized raw capsule again, allowing relative/tilde capsule selection to change with concurrent cwd/home change. Normal production capsule paths are absolute, so no demonstrated internal P0/P1, but arbitrary-path equivalence was incomplete.
initial_proposal_issue_fixed.fix: Corrected proposal anchors capsule_path = capsule.expanduser().absolute() once before target guard, then resolves that same anchored capsule_path strictly.

exact_scope_proof: Entire task_store module AST excluding _relative_target is unchanged. Only duplicate capsule/target ancestor check is consolidated; validation, strict capsule resolution, target resolution, containment and returned target remain. Atomic write guard in io.py is unchanged and revalidates independently.
guard_assessment: validate_relative_path retains rejection of absolute paths, backslashes, dot/dotdot/empty components, drive/colon/control/reserved-name escapes. Clean path parts cannot make joinpath discard the capsule root.
Fresh ensure_no_filesystem_links on full anchored target examines candidate and all parents, including capsule and every capsule ancestor, before capsule resolution. No parent component is omitted.

Missing/not-directory target descendants are skipped by the guard while parent validation continues. Strict capsule resolution still fails when required capsule root or an intermediate component is missing/not-directory.
Unexpected metadata/permission failures still propagate before recovery writes. Error ordering can differ because full target ancestry is checked before strict root resolution; both fail closed.

Actual capsule path that is itself a regular file is not newly rejected by this helper: strict resolve validates existence, not directory type, as before; downstream atomic write fails on invalid parent directory. No new directory-type guarantee asserted.

Symlink/junction capsule/ancestor/target checks remain; real linked target and missing descendant fixtures should be tested. Target resolve(strict=False) plus is_relative_to(capsule_root) continues to reject resolved escapes.

Recovery checks remain fresh per document. No cache, approval mutation, run-lock scope change, transaction ordering, state-last replacement change, checksum/data-format change or durability/fsync alteration.
race_boundary: Path validation followed by resolution/write is not race-free inode-handle traversal. A malicious root/link swap after checks remains a pre-existing accepted check-to-use boundary. Removing a duplicate check changes timing/count, so exact race-window or universally identical adversarial interleaving behavior is not claimed. The independent atomic-write guard remains fresh; target resolution/containment continues to reject ordinary descendant escapes.
required_focused_checks: Relative capsule with injected cwd change after target guard remains anchored to initially selected capsule.
Missing capsule/intermediate root fails strict resolution; ordinary missing descendant remains eligible.
Permission/unexpected metadata fault fails before any existing document bytes change.
Real target/ancestor symlink or Windows junction is denied, including missing descendants.
Retain Windows-separator traversal rejection and interrupted transaction roll-forward/event integrity tests.
qualification: Eligible bounded reversible metadata reduction after focused behavior checks and normal automatic review. Production sourcef7 remains unchanged.
